decision_rationale: This is a primary DNA foundation model for angiosperms. The evidence describes DNA tokenization and masked language modeling, but no natural-language text component.
evidence_snippet: “long-context DNA language model”; “single-nucleotide tokenization”; “masked language modeling objective applied to 8,192 bp input sequences”

decision_rationale: The paper is a primary generative biology model for transcriptomics-conditioned molecule design. The evidence supports biological conditioning, but no substantive natural-language/text component in the model itself.
evidence_snippet: “transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework”; “couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing foundation model with a molecular GPT model”

decision_rationale: This is a primary single-cell foundation model with diffusion post-training. The evidence stays within transcriptomic tokens and cell data, with no natural-language text component.
evidence_snippet: “masked language model pre-training, diffusion-driven post-training”; “large-scale single-cell data”; “34.2 million cells”

decision_rationale: This is a zero-shot application of an existing protein language model to structural risk scoring, not a new text-bio model. The evidence is limited to protein sequence modeling and score aggregation.
evidence_snippet: “applies the protein language model ESM-2, without fine-tuning”; “masked-token log-likelihood ratios”

decision_rationale: Raygun is a primary generative protein-design method, but the evidence is entirely protein-sequence/PLM based. No natural-language text component or substantive text-bio bridge is described.
evidence_snippet: Protein language models generate informative per-residue representations; Raygun implements this representation within an auto-encoder operating on ESM-2 embeddings

decision_rationale: Unify is a transfer-learning framework for scRNA-seq integration that combines RNA expression with precomputed language-model embeddings. The text side is used as external embeddings, not as a substantive text-bio generative model.
evidence_snippet: combining RNA expression with embeddings from protein language models and general-purpose language models

decision_rationale: scMIR is presented as a vision-language foundation model with paired microscopy images and textual captions. The text-guided alignment is central to the model, so this is within scope.
evidence_snippet: trained on paired single-cell images and structured textual captions to enable text-guided visual representation learning

decision_rationale: CellDuality is a primary LLM-based biological reasoning method: it defines biological tasks, constructs textual prompts, and trains the model to generate textual responses. The text-biology bridge is explicit and central.
evidence_snippet: All inputs to the LLM are constructed as textual prompts x; The model's output is a textual response y

decision_rationale: This is a primary multimodal model paper. The model uses a language-model backbone for biological tasks and explicitly generates natural-language explanations and a natural-language interface.
evidence_snippet: “shared Qwen3.5-9B backbone”; “natural-language explanations”; “Planner–Router–Verifier natural-language interface”; “encodes … spatial coordinates as … sectors of text”

decision_rationale: This is a wrapper/system paper that integrates external foundation-model embeddings and external LLMs for downstream spatial and report tasks. The text element is present, but it is used as an attached component rather than a new primary text-bio foundation model.
evidence_snippet: “integrating external knowledge as embeddings extracted from FMs”; “GPT-4o and o1”; “gene information as prompts”; “text embeddings of gene information”

decision_rationale: This is an empirical analysis of existing single-cell foundation models, not a new primary model. The representations are transcriptome-based, with no natural-language text component.
evidence_snippet: “We conduct a systematic empirical analysis of four SCFMs”; “trained with the same masked-token recipe on transcriptomes”

decision_rationale: The provided evidence is truncated, but what is shown centers on PubTator-derived gene relations and graph construction rather than a substantive text-bio generative model. No clear natural-language component is evidenced.
